name: Bearly Baking
detailed_description:
Bearly Baking is a cooking and relationship-building game where you play as a bear running an inn to feed animals for hibernation. You cook bread and muffins in small mini-games, and based on the quality, you build better relationships with your patrons and learn more about their stories.

Take orders from customers and then return to the kitchen to prepare their meal of baked goods with various batter mix-ins and toppings. Prepare the meal as close as possible to their specifications and earn stars for a well-job done! Remember, more is always better!

Earn stars from the patrons to progress your relationship with them and find out more about each of their individual stories. Interact with them during these conversations, and earn more bonus stars as well, to help them along their way faster.

Watch out though! There's a new business man in town, and he wants the B&B Cafe! Scrounge up enough stars to buy the land out from underneath him, and safe the family cafe!

Use your stars later to purchase unique household items for your own customizable home, and make it your own! Stars used for purchase do not count as being lost for story purposes.
